title: Player test bug fixes: equip/unequip, destructible spacing, pet speed, camera, E-key, UI, leaderboard, data saving
description: Comprehensive bug fix and improvement pass based on player testing: 1. Fix pet equip/unequip completely with debug prints. 2. Shared position list for all destructible types with 15-stud min distance. 3. Slow pet movement (lerp 1.5), ground-level (height 0-0.5). 4. Pet attack cancellation on click elsewhere or player moving away. 5. Remove camera effect from egg animation. 6. E-key direct hatch (no menu). 7. BillboardGui showing egg contents with percentages. 8. Remove equipped pet bar UI. 9. Leaderboard (leaderstats with Level and Diamonds). 10. Data save with memory-only mode message.
steps: Fix PetService equip/unequip with debug prints
Fix destructible spawning with shared position tracking and 15-stud minimum distance
Set pet follow speed to 1.5 and height to 0.5 (ground level)
Add pet attack cancellation when player clicks elsewhere or moves away
Remove camera effect from egg hatch animation in EffectsController
Make E-key directly hatch egg without menu overlay
Add BillboardGui at egg stations showing pet probabilities
Remove equipped pet bar from UIController
Fix DataService with memory-only mode message
